Sciatic Schwannoma: F2: 8-month history of radicular pain radiating from lower back down the left leg
F3: Pain characteristics: occasional tingling, progressively worsened, severe by August
F5: Examination findings: mild hypesthesia in the left L5–S1 dermatome
F8: Electromyography findings: neuropathic irritation of the left L4, L5, S1, and S2 roots, most severe at L5, with no denervation
F9: Lumbosacral gadolinium-enhanced MRI findings: solitary, completely cystic mass in the left L5–S1 foraminal zone
F10: Mass characteristics: approximately 13.9 cm in length and 1.9 cm in maximal diameter, hypointense on T1-weighted images, hyperintense on T2-weighted images, peripheral rim enhancement
F11: Mass location: extending along the course of the sciatic nerve into the left ischial groove, causing severe foraminal stenosis without attachment to pelvic organs
F12: MR neurography findings: mass arose from the sciatic nerve at the left ischial groove
